overall_goal: Prepare the blender and add all the required ingredients for the mango lassi.

goals.description: Retrieve the blender from the cupboard.
goals.rationale: The person pulls the blender out of the cupboard and untangles its cord to prepare it for use.

goals.description: Clear counter space and plug in the blender.
goals.rationale: The person moves items on the counter to make room, places the blender down, and plugs it into the socket.

goals.description: Rinse the blender and set it up on the counter.
goals.rationale: The person takes the blender cup to the sink, rinses it, drains the water, and sets it back up on the counter.

goals.description: Retrieve utensils and prepare the blender for ingredients.
goals.rationale: The person gets tablespoons from a drawer and removes the blender lid to start adding ingredients.

goals.description: Measure and add yogurt to the blender.
goals.rationale: The person opens the yogurt, measures it into a cup, and pours it into the blender.

goals.description: Peel mangoes and add slices to the blender.
goals.rationale: The person separates the mango flesh from the skin and places the pieces into the blender cup.
The person uses a tablespoon to scoop honey from a jar and adds it to the blender.

goals.description: Retrieve ice and water from the freezer and add ice to the blender.
goals.rationale: The person gets an ice tray and cold water from the freezer, then pops out ice cubes into the blender.

goals.description: Measure cold water and pour it into the blender.
goals.rationale: The person pours cold water into the measuring cup, stirs it to collect leftover ingredients, and pours it into the blender.

goals.description: Add remaining mango bits to the blender.
goals.rationale: The person scoops up the rest of the mango pieces from the chopping board and adds them to the blender.
